intro: South Sudan is a presidential republic under a transitional peace agreement.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Salva Kiir has led since independence. Elections have been delayed several times. In 2025 Riek Machar was arrested and charged, threatening the peace deal.

chapters.title: UN mission
text: A UN peacekeeping mission protects civilians.
